# implicitRungeKuttaErrorEstimateTest.py

You can view and download this file on Github: [implicitRungeKuttaErrorEstimateTest.py](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/tree/master/python/TestModels/implicitRungeKuttaErrorEstimateTest.py)

```{code-block} python
:linenos:

#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
# This is an EXUDYN example
#
# Details:  timeIntegration.errorEstimate of the implicit Runge-Kutta solvers (#3287): the automatic step size of
#           LobattoIIIA4 and TrapezoidalGGL on a mass on a spring with the error estimate 'oneStep' (against the
#           trapezoidal rule) and 'twoSteps' (the quadrature against the stage velocities of two steps); 'default' is
#           'twoSteps' for LobattoIIIA4 and 'oneStep' for TrapezoidalGGL; both estimates keep the error at the end
#           near the tolerance; any other value is refused. The result is the number of checks that pass plus the
#           numbers of steps.
#
# Author:   Johannes Gerstmayr
# Date:     2026-11-06
#
# Copyright:This file is part of Exudyn. Exudyn is free software. You can redistribute it and/or modify it under the terms of the Exudyn license. See 'LICENSE.txt' for more details.
#
#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

import exudyn as exu
import exudyn.cMath as cMath #the math functions of the C++ code, the same bits on every platform
import numpy as np
import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
import modelLibrary

testIsActive = exu.sys.get('testIsActive', False)
checks = []

def Solve(solverType, errorEstimate, automaticStepSize=True, stepSize=0.05):
    """the ODE2 coordinates of the mass on the spring at t = 1 and the number of steps"""
    mbs = modelLibrary.GetModel('massOscillator')
    simulationSettings = modelLibrary.SimulationSettings(mbs, stepSize, 1.)
    simulationSettings.timeIntegration.automaticStepSize = automaticStepSize
    simulationSettings.timeIntegration.absoluteTolerance = 1e-6
    simulationSettings.timeIntegration.relativeTolerance = 1e-6
    simulationSettings.timeIntegration.errorEstimate = errorEstimate
    mbs.SolveDynamic(simulationSettings, solverType=solverType)
    return (np.array(mbs.systemData.GetODE2Coordinates()), mbs.sys['dynamicSolver'].it.currentStepIndex)

qReference = Solve(exu.DynamicSolverType.LobattoIIIA4, 'default', automaticStepSize=False, stepSize=1e-3)[0]
u = 0
for (solverType, default) in [(exu.DynamicSolverType.LobattoIIIA4, 'twoSteps'), (exu.DynamicSolverType.TrapezoidalGGL, 'oneStep')]:
    results = {errorEstimate: Solve(solverType, errorEstimate) for errorEstimate in ['default', 'oneStep', 'twoSteps']}
    for (errorEstimate, (q, steps)) in results.items():
        exu.Print(str(solverType).split('.')[-1], errorEstimate, ': steps', steps, ', error', cMath.norm(q - qReference))
    checks += [results['default'][1] == results[default][1] and np.max(np.abs(results['default'][0] - results[default][0])) == 0]
    checks += [results['oneStep'][1] != results['twoSteps'][1]]
    checks += [all(cMath.norm(q - qReference) < 1e-3 for (q, steps) in results.values())]
    u += results['oneStep'][1] + results['twoSteps'][1]

try:
    Solve(exu.DynamicSolverType.LobattoIIIA4, 'twoStep')
    checks += [False]
except Exception as e:
    checks += ['errorEstimate' in str(e)]

u += sum(checks)
exu.Print('checks:', checks)
exu.Print('solution of implicitRungeKuttaErrorEstimateTest=', u)
exu.sys['testResult'] = u
```
